items: Identify Manipulation Tactics: Name the specific tactics being used against you—whether it's DARVO, guilt-tripping, silent treatment, or threats of self-harm—so you can see them clearly instead of doubting yourself.
Identify Manipulation Tactics: Pinpoint which manipulation tactics have been used most frequently on you so you can anticipate when they're about to be deployed against you.
Identify Manipulation Tactics: Notice when the manipulation escalates, which typically happens right when you're trying to pull away, so you can prepare for the hardest moments.
Identify Manipulation Tactics: Track how you've automatically responded to each manipulation tactic so you understand exactly where your vulnerability points are.
Understand Your Triggers: Name your specific triggers that make you want to reach out even when you've mentally decided the friendship is over.
Understand Your Triggers: Identify the physical sensations in your body when guilt or fear spikes so you can recognize when your nervous system is being hijacked.
Understand Your Triggers: Recognize how threats of self-harm create a hostage situation that makes you feel responsible for protecting someone who is manipulating you.
Understand Your Triggers: Notice the pattern of unpredictable warmth followed by coldness that has created a neurological attachment stronger than consistent reward would have.
Prepare Your Exit Plan: Build a set of regulation tools to use when guilt or fear spikes hit so you don't have to rely on willpower alone during the exit.
Prepare Your Exit Plan: Create crystal-clear boundaries about what you will and will not accept before you begin the exit process so you have something to refer to when pressure mounts.
Prepare Your Exit Plan: Develop a specific exit plan tailored to your situation that accounts for your particular triggers rather than using a generic script or template.
Prepare Your Exit Plan: Decide in advance how you will handle threats and when you will block or fade, prioritizing your own safety over maintaining access for the toxic person.
